title: Narrowing casts and `INT`/`TINYINT` arithmetic past the width raise
verdict: `CAST(BIGINT AS INT)` out of range and `INT + INT` past 32 bits raise
description: A cast to a narrower integer that does not fit raises a `Conversion Error`; `+` of `INT` or `TINYINT` values past their width raises an `Out of Range Error` (no promotion to `BIGINT`).
reference: `UnFn.narrow` and `UnFn.wrap` raise where the value does not fit (`badCast`, `wraps`; #202): DuckDB raises natively.

provenance.checked_by: #1166 restatement probe (session youthful-margulis), duckdb 2.0.0, macOS arm64

evidence.observed: Conversion Error: Type INT64 with value 1099511627776 can't be cast because the value is out of range for the destination type INT32

evidence.sql: select cast(2147483647 as int) + cast(1 as int)
evidence.observed: Out of Range Error: Overflow in addition of INT32 (2147483647 + 1)!

evidence.sql: select cast(127 as tinyint) + cast(1 as tinyint)
evidence.observed: Out of Range Error: Overflow in addition of INT8 (127 + 1)!
